scientific_integrity: Exact analytic endpoint inequalities for one to three phases and exact rational four-phase witness; finite verifier supplements rather than proves unrestricted statements; no empirical or independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two patches; seasonal diagonal fitnesses strictly positive; a single fixed unconditional dispersal parameter; equal redistribution pool; deterministic linear model. No extension claimed for nonlinear, stochastic, asymmetric, or multisite landscapes. Previously unknown equivalent stronger theorems remain possible.
title: Four seasons are necessary and sufficient for interior-optimal dispersal in a two-patch periodic model
